scope: Exploratory correlations in frozen control900, same 100 old development questions,32k evidence, equal1/16 total rows. No rerun, score change, reranking or training.

methods.position: Exact equality of required-source unit text against numbered passages from saved rebuilt full evidence. Validate the intended shuffled location using the pinned builder seed and own-source-first construction.
methods.bins: Early:0<=j/(N-1)<1/3; middle:1/3<=j/(N-1)<2/3; late:2/3<=j/(N-1)<=1. j is zero-based passage position, N is the per-item passage count.
methods.ambiguity: Primary analysis excludes any item whose exact required source appears more than once. All100 have one source unit; no multi-unit positions are collapsed.
methods.token_check: Sensitivity uses cumulative recorded separate-part encoder lengths and the source part midpoint. This includes repeated question/template overhead and is a proxy, not the exact token offset in merged encoding.
methods.semantics: Reuse existing source-grounded labels. Fully supported means status=correct; partial answers remain separate. Show original supported-reference and pre-existing adjusted-reference denominators; create no new gold corrections.
methods.nll: All uniquely located questions retained for literal gold-answer NLL, including annotation concerns. Mean within question then equal mean across questions.
methods.limitations: One fixed checkpoint and shuffle, nonrandom old development cohort, unequal small domain bins. Associations are not causal position effects or evidence of a capacity limit; source elsewhere can also contain useful/ambiguous information.
